Mentoring subscriptions

Availability

Available to customers in the United States only. We cannot accept orders or subscriptions from customers outside the United States.

Each plan includes one dedicated hour per week to ask questions, discuss problems and develop action plans to move forward as a leader.

Booking sessions

After you subscribe we email you a private link to our calendar. Use it to book your sessions. Please do not share the link.

Cancellation and refunds

  1. Send your cancellation as written notice (email is fine) to leadership@crucibleleadershipguild.com.
  2. To receive a prorated refund for unused sessions, we must receive your notice at least 30 days before your cancellation takes effect. Your cancellation takes effect 30 days after we receive your notice, or on a later date you name. You can keep booking sessions until then.
  3. Your refund covers sessions you have paid for that fall after the date your cancellation takes effect. It is calculated as the number of those unused sessions multiplied by the per-session price (the plan price divided by the number of weekly sessions in that billing period).
  4. Sessions during the 30-day notice period, and sessions already held or missed, are not refunded.
  5. Refunds go back to the original payment method. Any tax collected on the refunded amount is refunded too.
  6. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under the consumer laws where you live.

Example

The Pro plan costs $150.00 for 4 weekly sessions, so each session is worth $37.50. If your cancellation takes effect after the first session of a paid period, the remaining 3 sessions are refunded: 3 × $37.50 = $112.50.
